name: My Bookmarks under Jellyfin Enhanced's Hidden Content, in the je sandbox with Jellyfin Enhanced's Hidden Content switched on and one movie hidden by viewer (bookmarks-je-web-probe.mjs sets both up through JE's own APIs, with viewer's 'je-hidden' bookmarks on the hidden movie and on a visible one): as viewer, My Bookmarks searched for 'je-hidden', grouped and flat; what JE's script hides on our page is recorded (each group and row, shown or hidden, and JE's je-hidden class) and the probe judges it. The page must render either way.

steps.name: the Bookmarks script ran and JE loaded
JE's observer has had its time
what is shown: each group and its rows
steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"]'); const shown = (e) => !!e && e.getClientRects().length > 0 && getComputedStyle(e).display !== 'none'; return { count: (p.querySelector('.jfbm-page-count') || {}).textContent || null, groups: Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-group[data-jfbm-group]')).map(g => { const h = g.querySelector('.jfbm-group-header'); return { key: g.getAttribute('data-jfbm-group'), shown: shown(g), jeHidden: g.classList.contains('je-hidden'), header: h ? { dataId: h.getAttribute('data-id'), classes: h.className, shown: shown(h), jeHidden: h.classList.contains('je-hidden'), title: (h.querySelector('.listItemBodyText') || h).textContent.trim().slice(0, 80) } : null, rows: Array.from(g.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row')).map(r => ({ id: r.getAttribute('data-id'), shown: shown(r), jeHidden: r.classList.contains('je-hidden') })) }; }) }; })()

steps.name: what is shown: each row
steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"]'); const shown = (e) => e.getClientRects().length > 0 && getComputedStyle(e).display !== 'none'; return Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row')).map(r => ({ id: r.getAttribute('data-id'), classes: r.className, shown: shown(r), jeHidden: r.classList.contains('je-hidden') })); })()

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag and jellyfin-web's Home tab slider excepted)
